name: LinkedIn Ads
description: Manage LinkedIn advertising campaigns, ad accounts, creatives, and audience targeting through the LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform.
primary_blocker: Advertising API access requires application submission and partner/admin approval from LinkedIn.

evidence.claim: The LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for member authorization and API authentication.
To apply for access to private APIs, first submit an application for the Advertising API with an ads management or reporting use case.
Community MCP server exists for LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Ads management.

notes: Access to LinkedIn Marketing APIs requires creating an app on the LinkedIn Developer Portal and explicitly applying for the Advertising API product catalog. It uses 3-legged OAuth 2.0.
search_queries_used: LinkedIn Ads authentication OAuth API key developer docs
